Docs.summary: Provides pluggable response state persistence for the Responses API server.

remarks.para: The SDK delegates all response state operations to the registered . Consumers extend this class to support custom backends (e.g., Redis, SQL) for multi-instance deployments.
Event streaming is handled by the Core event-stream primitive, not by this provider. For cancellation signalling, extend .
When no custom implementation is registered, the SDK provides an in-memory default that is automatically registered by AddResponsesServer().
